name: Nix
description: Install Nix and prepare the development environment declared in a dev.nix file or a flake devShell when the container is created or started

version.description: Select or enter a Nix version to install

file.description: Path of the environment file, relative to the workspace folder. Use a dev.nix file, or a flake.nix file to load one of its devShells. Nothing is prepared when the file does not exist.

devShell.description: Name of the devShell to load when the file is a flake.nix

channel.description: Default nixpkgs channel when dev.nix does not set `channel`. Accepts stable-<release>, unstable, a nixpkgs branch name or a nixpkgs commit. Not used for flake.nix.

allowUnfree.description: Allow packages with an unfree license. Not used for flake.nix.

autoRebuild.description: Rebuild the environment on container start when the environment file, its flake.lock or the options changed since the last build
